corrections.correction: Clarified conductivity question because zinc can also be brittle at room temperature, making the original broad property wording ambiguous.

corrections.sourceFile: Year 10 Chemistry End of Topic Test (Draft 2).docx
corrections.correction: Specified O₂ gas; the original oxygen wording also permits an atomic interpretation.
Clarified ambiguous source wording: food availability can influence selection, so it cannot simply be said never to contribute to evolution.
Corrected key sequence E–B–E–A–C to E–B–D–A–C after diagram inspection.
Corrected key redshift to blueshift, and nearest neighbouring galaxy to nearby large galaxy.
Clarified higher intensity for the requested higher thermal-emission curve.
Clarified larger as initial mass, not radius.

corrections.sourceFile: Year 10 Physical Sciences Mid Topic Test 2017.doc
corrections.correction: Source has two questions numbered 4. Preserved map question separately; key changes distance between parts, so worked solution uses consistent measured distance.

corrections.sourceFile: Year 10 Physical Sciences Mid Topic Test 2017.doc
corrections.correction: Corrected mass unit 1000 N to 1000 kg, as the supplied key directs.
Specified oxygen-16 because neutron number depends on isotope.
Changed velocity to speed because only distance and time are supplied.
Corrected key maximum-speed statement; reworded final comparison to the first 50 m because the original maximum-energy comparison is not generally valid.
Corrected original option D, which incorrectly ended with a red dwarf.

Replaced unsupported source claims about the Y chromosome lacking vital genes and X being resistant to mutation with accurate replication-error context. Preserved the assessed cell-division and evolution skills.
